scope: Admit the qualified owned NTFS name-correspondence observation through existing image.inspect and common CLI/stdio/GUI/TUI/shell actions. This is exact raw-name/parent/namespace correspondence for one observed directory, not complete namespace, collation, uniqueness, lookup, content, current-source authority or mutation. Original all-platform/storage 0.1.0 remains the programme scope.
ownership: Extend existing runtime/capture/ntfs_inspection, platform/windows/storage/ntfs_reader, canonical command/schema and common response classifier. Preserve one command registry, worker host, native opener, snapshot and frontend action path. No new production file, directory, frontend model or protocol ABI freeze.
invocation: Existing image.inspect PATH adds --view ntfs-membership. Explicit canonical decimal-u64 volume-offset and volume-bytes>=512 must sum to <=9223372036854775807. Preserve --ntfs-version auto|3.0|3.1 default auto. --directory-reference is 0 (default root FILE5) or a full u64 with nonzero high16 sequence, as in ntfs-directory. Add optional --ntfs-target-limit / ntfs_target_limit, canonical decimal string 1..256 default64, admitted only by ntfs-membership. Reject zero/overflow/noncanonical/typed-invalid/wrong-view/unrelated controls before source access. Old view names, wires, defaults, results and invocation outcomes remain compatible.

names: Preserve name_hex as exact original bytes. Use existing escaped-utf16le-code-units/1 display: lowercase hex length multiple4 <=1020; printable ASCII except quote/backslash is literal, quote/backslash backslash-escaped, other UTF16 units literal backslash-u-four-hex separately including surrogates. outcomes: Complete/applicable/stable matched observations return completed0. A complete, stable, source-agreeing observation whose sole diagnostic is ntfs_membership_name_mismatch and whose collection is complete with all_edges_matched=false returns failed4 with that exact diagnostic, without ntfs_capture_incomplete. Partial/unsupported/budget/malformed/version-mismatch observations return failed4 ntfs_capture_incomplete with retained precise observation diagnostic. Source disagreement returns failed4 ntfs_source_changed; unresolved lifecycle unknown6; missing/denied/unavailable rejected3; invalid parameter2 without source/port access; malformed bound result internal_error4; full response overflow ntfs_report_limit4. No durable operation ID. Existing outcomes remain unchanged.
presentation: Add the new scope to the existing shared ntfs_inspection_response classifier. All frontends retain the same action/descriptor/response, source-free static discovery and essential availability. Canonical response remains<=524287 bytes plus framing LF,65536 values,depth48,string bytes<=32768; existing GUI wrapper allowances only. testing: Define generated source layouts and raw expected tuples independently before first evaluation. Exercise both profiles/auto/nonroot/above4GiB, empty/matched/mismatch/aliases/duplicate-instance/partial/budget outcomes, raw control/surrogate names, target limit boundaries and old-view rejection. Compare actual owned worker bytes to pure projection including every original-list hash/nested prefix/omission; malformed fields/request-domain/target schema and output overflow reject. Launch actual CLI human/JSON, stdio JSON/NDJSON, GUI/TUI/shell against same generated source with stable semantics/source hashes, exact process/context/retirement, large display and no raw controls. Invalid inputs must hit existing fault-only source-open guard before opening. Preserve actual hang/cancel/late-result/source/slot retention and essential-command behaviour. acceptance: Canonical schema, compiled parser, typed request and tooling agree on membership-only target controls and signed source window; old view/default/result compatibility remains. All invalid in-scope inputs reject before source access.

Actual owned worker data appears consistently through common frontends with exact original/derived projection, unchanged source hashes, correct mismatch versus incomplete outcomes, sealed controls and actual-exit identity. Claims remain bounded raw correspondence.
